SELECT
  "leg_1"."Customer" AS "Customer",
  CAST(SUM("leg_0"."Total Amount") AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS "Total Amount"
FROM "leg_0" AS "leg_0"
LEFT JOIN "leg_1" AS "leg_1"
  ON "leg_0"."__fk0_0" = "leg_1"."__fk0_0"
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY
  "leg_1"."Customer" ASC
LIMIT 1000

  SUM("Orders"."amount") AS "Total Amount"
FROM "t"."orders" AS "Orders"
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY
  "__fk0_0" ASC
LIMIT 5000001
